title: go-mutants doctor report v1
description: What `go-mutants doctor --json` found about this machine: one row per check, each with a status and a line of detail. It is a diagnosis of the environment rather than a measurement of any code, so it carries no run id, no workspace digest, and no mutants.

checks.description: Every check the tool ran, in the order the table prints them. The list is complete even when a check failed: a diagnosis that stopped at the first problem would hide the second one.

name.description: What was checked, in the same words the table prints. Stable within a schema version, so a consumer may branch on it.

status.description: ok is a check that passed. warn is a check that failed on something only an opt-in feature needs, and never fails the command. fail is a check go-mutants cannot work without, and any one of them exits 2.

detail.description: One line naming what was found: the version, the path, or the reason it could not be. Never empty, because a status with nothing beside it is a verdict a reader cannot act on.
